title: Frame preservation under symbol lifting
statement: Let $e$ embed the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$, and let $D$ be a one-work-tape configuration of the flag-phase machine on input $x$. If decoding the symbols of $D$ and running the Boolean decrement machine for $T$ steps leaves its output empty, then at every time $u\le T$ the lifted decrement machine on $\Gamma$ has the same input-head position and output as $D$, and its work-tape head position agrees with that of the decoded Boolean computation.
